project.description: Freestyle CI job for ResilAI - UI-configured (not pipeline-as-code). Runs unit tests, Selenium browser tests, and chaos experiments.

hudson.tasks.BatchCommand.command: cd /d "D:\UserData\Desktop\ResilAI" && if not exist results mkdir results && ".venv\Scripts\pytest.exe" tests/ -v --junitxml=results/unit-test-results.xml 2>&1

cd /d "D:\UserData\Desktop\ResilAI" && powershell -Command "for ($i=0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/health' -TimeoutSec 2; if ($r.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Output 'Flask app is healthy'; exit 0 } } catch {} ; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; Write-Output 'Health check failed - aborting'; exit 1"
cd /d "D:\UserData\Desktop\ResilAI" && ".venv\Scripts\python.exe" chaos/run_experiments.py 2 3 2>&1 || echo "Chaos experiments completed (some may have warnings)"
cd /d "D:\UserData\Desktop\ResilAI" && taskkill /F /IM python.exe /T 2>nul || echo "No flask process to stop"
